title: Characterization of the marine medaka AHRs and the comparison with those of Japanese medaka in response to dioxin and additional AHR ligands.
authors: Zhang, Wanglong; Zong, Yanjiao; Sun, Ruize; Xue, Zhenhong; Wan, Wenhui; Ren, Anran; Ma, Yongchao; Tian, Wenjing; Wang, Renjun
one_liner_zh: 该文表征海洋青鳉AHR亚型对二噁英等配体的敏感性差异，并用计算建模（分子对接）比较AHR-配体互作，虽涉及蛋白-配体而非TF-DNA，但对接建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The global water pollution now calls for precise risk assessment of chemicals, e.g., dioxins and the dioxin-like compounds (DLCs). The freshwater and marine medaka have been widely implemented in the toxicity testing, and perhaps give mechanistic information for comparative biology. The question that 'will they report equal results due to their close phylogenetic relation' has been raised, therefore, we explored their physiological and molecular responses to dioxin. As the mediator of the dioxin toxicity, the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) of marine medaka (Oryzias melastigma) has not been functionally characterized and might be species-specific. In terms of sensitivity to dioxin-2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin (TCDD), the EC(50) values of omeAHR1a (0.16+/-0.12 nM), omeAHR1b (2.96+/-2.96 nM), omeAHR2a (0.44+/-0.30 nM), and omeAHR2b (9.00+/-6.88 nM) exhibit marked variations. The omeAHR2a and omeAHR1a display heightened sensitivity compared to the freshwater Japanese medaka (Oryzias latipes) counterparts olaAHR2a and olaAHR1a, respectively. The results indicate the in vitro sensitivity of AHR among species can vary by one or two orders of magnitude. Further mechanistic investigations using additional ligands and computational modeling reveal that: 1) most of omeAHR2a, olaAHR2a, dreAHR2, and hsaAHR interact with ligands in the affinity order of TCDD > PCB126 > BNF > indole, mirroring their AHR transactivation potency, but the docking poses and dynamics can vary; 2) one AHR subform's high sensitivity to dioxin-TCDD may extend to DLCs but not to other types of ligands. Beyond the in vitro study, the preliminary in vivo LC(50) data indicate that marine medaka (LC(50): 1.64 ng/L (95 % CI: 1.05-2.55 ng/L)) has similar sensitivity, and possibly slightly greater (not statistically determined yet), to TCDD in comparison with Japanese medaka (LC(50): 3.42 ng/L (95 % CI: 1.37-6.48 ng/L)).These insights underscore the difference of AHR biology among species even the close relative species, and point out the necessity for meticulous consideration when evaluating the toxicity of compounds and when extending predictive toxicity assessments to more species.
abstract_zh: 全球水污染问题现需对化学品（如二噁英及其类二噁英化合物（DLCs））进行精确的风险评估。淡水及海洋青鳉已被广泛用于毒性测试，并可能为比较生物学提供机制性信息。由于它们系统发育关系密切，有人提出疑问：“它们是否会报告相同的结果？”因此，我们探讨了它们对二噁英的生理和分子响应。作为二噁英毒性的介导者，海洋青鳉（Oryzias melastigma）的芳基烃受体（AHR）尚未被功能表征，且可能具有物种特异性。就二噁英-2,3,7,8-四氯二苯并-p-二噁英（TCDD）的敏感性而言，omeAHR1a（0.16±0.12 nM）、omeAHR1b（2.96±2.96 nM）、omeAHR2a（0.44±0.30 nM）和omeAHR2b（9.00±6.88 nM）的EC(50)值表现出显著差异。omeAHR2a和omeAHR1a分别比淡水日本青鳉（Oryzias latipes）的对应物olaAHR2a和olaAHR1a显示出更高的敏感性。结果表明，不同物种间AHR的体外敏感性可能相差一到两个数量级。使用额外配体和计算建模的进一步机制研究揭示：1）大多数omeAHR2a、olaAHR2a、dreAHR2和hsaAHR以TCDD > PCB126 > BNF >吲哚的亲和力顺序与配体相互作用，这反映了它们的AHR反式激活效力，但对接姿态和动力学可能有所不同；2）一种AHR亚型对二噁英-TCDD的高敏感性可能扩展到DLCs，但不适用于其他类型的配体。在体外研究之外，初步的体内LC(50)数据表明，海洋青鳉（LC(50)：1.64 ng/L（95%置信区间：1.05-2.55 ng/L））与日本青鳉（LC(50)：3.42 ng/L（95%置信区间：1.37-6.48 ng/L））相比，对TCDD具有相似的敏感性，且可能略高（尚未经统计学确定）。这些见解强调了不同物种间（即使是近缘物种）AHR生物学的差异，并指出了在评估化合物毒性及将预测性毒性评估扩展到更多物种时需谨慎考虑的必要性。
